body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-07-31 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "we are confident of delivering a 25% plus revenue growth for FY '26" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: >=+25% (FY25 base INR 4,624 cr -> >= INR 5,780 cr). Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: FY26 +20.1% vs >=25% (raised from 20-25% in Apr-25). Ratio 0.80 on growth rate; revenue 5,553 vs >=5,780 cr = 96% of the revenue level. Explanation given: Nov-25: Rajasthan monsoon (timing). Jan-26: capacity delay + monsoon; '25% ... was our aspirational growth'. All in answer to analyst questions.
